Sub:- Delegation of Administrative and Financial Powers -reg.

Sir,

The last amendment in the Delegation of Financial Powers was done during
the year 2004. With a view to further review the delegation of Administrative
and Financial Powers of the Organization, suggestions/inputs are invited from all
the Field Offices (including Head Office) within 15 days from the issue of this

letter.
Yours-faithfully,

(Anil 0.K.)
Regional P.F. Commissioner-I(HRD)
